## Category Strategy Project of Tesla Electronic Batteries

•	Conducted market and industry analysis, identifying key trends, competitive benchmarks, and strategic options to optimize Tesla’s battery procurement strategy, aligning it with business goals

•	Formulated a sustainable procurement strategy, collaborating with ethical suppliers and integrating recycling and circular economy practices to reduce costs and enhance resource use in battery production

•	Developed a roadmap and risk management plan, setting performance metrics to drive cost reduction, supplier compliance, and innovation, to ensure Tesla’s goals of sustainability and market leadership


## Business Proposal for RUVroom (Ride-Sharing App)

•	Worked in a team of three and successfully developed a comprehensive business proposal for a new ride-sharing platform, RUVroom

•	Outlined strategic and financial objectives, including growth targets and a focus on national and global market expansion, aimed at maximizing both customer and shareholder value

•	Utilized the SIPOC model (Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs, Customers) to break down and streamline service delivery, improving operational efficiency and customer experience
